items.headline: Moline, Silvis water partnership becomes permanent after 3 years of testing
items.summary: Moline began supplying water to parts of Silvis in March of 2023 after years of low water pressure in Silvis and excess capacity at Moline's treatment plant.

items.headline: Some Veterans Day events canceled, postponed due to weather
items.summary: Davenport's annual parade has been canceled due to lightning and pouring rain. Meanwhile, across the river in Silvis, the Hero Street ceremony has been delayed.

items.headline: Date set for reopening of Captain’s Table in Moline
items.summary: The owners of Stumphy's Restaurant and Bar in Geneseo took over the restaurant and revived the Captain's Table name. It's set to reopen on Nov. 17.
